introduce: Sit on a chair with your back straight. Slowly extend your left leg until it is straight and parallel to the ground, then slowly lower it down. Repeat the exercise.
name: OPEN CHAIN KNEE EXTENSION LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Do this exercise slowly and don't use the impulsive force.
Don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.

introduce: Sit on a chair with your back straight. Slowly extend your right leg until it is straight and parallel to the ground, then slowly lower it down. Repeat the exercise.
name: OPEN CHAIN KNEE EXTENSION RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Do this exercise slowly and don't use the impulsive force.
Don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.

introduce:
Sit straight in the chair with your feet flat on the floor. 

Then lift your arms overhead and stretch your chest out. When you exhale, lower your arms until they're parallel to the floor. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: BACK ARCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you lift your arms and exhale when you lower.
This exercise helps stretch your upper body.

introduce:
Sit straight in the chair with your feet flat on the floor. 

Grab the left edge of your chair with your right hand. Then reach your left arm overhead, and bend your body to the right. 

Hold this position.
name: SIDE BEND REACH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe naturally.
You can feel your obliques stretched.
This exercise is good for your lower back.

introduce:
Sit straight in the chair with your feet flat on the floor. 

Grab the right edge of your chair with your left hand. Then reach your right arm overhead and bend your body to the left. 

Hold this position.
name: SIDE BEND REACH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe naturally.
You can feel your obliques stretched.
This exercise is good for your lower back.

introduce: Sit up nice and tall in the chair. Reach your left palm forward. Take your right hand over these fingers.\n\nGently pull the fingers of your left hand toward your body. Hold for a while and back to the starting position and repeat.
name: CHAIR FOREARM STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Exhale when you pull and inhale when you release fingers.
This exercise stretches your forearm.

introduce: Sit up nice and tall in the chair. Reach your right palm forward. Take your left hand over these fingers.\n\nGently pull the fingers of your right hand toward your body. Hold for a while and back to the starting position and repeat.
name: CHAIR FOREARM STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Exhale when you pull and inhale when you release fingers.
This exercise stretches your forearm.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair. 

Tuck your chin, and round your back as you exhale. Then take a breath in, and look up, trying to drive your chest out. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR CAT COW

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you drive your chest out, and exhale when you round your back.
You should not feel tenseness in your shoulders or back.
This exercise works on your upper back and helps stretch your spine.

introduce: Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands on your thighs.\n\nRock back and forth from your toes to your heels. Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR HEEL TO TOE ROCK

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet parallel and your ankles stable.
Please pause at the top for a few seconds.
Please do it slowly.
This exercise is great for improving ankle mobility and balance.

introduce: Sit upright with your back straight and feet flat on the floor. Bend your knees at 90 degrees with your feet together.\n\nLift one knee toward your chest and then lower it. Switch to the other side and repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR HIGH KNEES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
If you feel it\'s too easy, do it as fast as you can.
Lift your knees toward your chest as high as comfortably possible.
Exhale as you lift your knee, and inhale as you lower it.

introduce: Sit with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle. Keep your back straight and your hands behind your ears.\n\nRaise your right knee, and use your left elbow to touch your right knee. Change sides and repeat.
name: CHAIR ELBOW TO KNEE CRUNCH

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Tighten your abdominals during the exercise.
Raise your knee up as high as you can.
Squeeze your abdominals with each crunch.
Exhale as you lift your knees and inhale when lowering them.
This exercise works on your entire core.

introduce: Sit upright with your back straight and feet flat on the floor. Bend your knees at 90 degrees with your feet hip-width apart. Put your hands beside your ears.\n\nRotate your body gently and slowly. This stretches your back and hips.
name: CHAIR TORSO TWIST

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please rotate your body gently and slowly.
Your toes and knees should always face forward.
Make sure your abs muscles are engaged.
Please relax your shoulders.
This exercise stretches your back and hips.

introduce: Sit upright with your back straight and feet flat on the floor. Bend your knees at 90 degrees with your feet hip-width apart.\n\nLift your left arm overhead and extend your left leg straight outward. Return to the starting position and then switch to the other side. Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR HIGH REACH

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
Extend your arms and legs as far as you can.
Don\'t lean your upper body left or right.
Focus on lengthening your spine and stretching your torso.

introduce: Sit upright with your back straight and feet flat on the floor. Bend your knees at 90 degrees with your feet hip-width apart.\n\nSlightly lift left leg off the ground, and then spread it outward. Bring it back and repeat.
name: CHAIR HIP ABDUCTION LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
Keep the other foot on the ground.
Don't rotate your torso.
Your knees should face the same direction as your toes.
This exercise works on your hips and improves hip stability.

introduce: Sit upright with your back straight and feet flat on the floor. Bend your knees at 90 degrees with your feet hip-width apart.\n\nSlightly lift right leg off the ground, and then spread it outward. Bring it back and repeat.
name: CHAIR HIP ABDUCTION RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
Keep the other foot on the ground.
Don't rotate your torso.
Your knees should face the same direction as your toes.
This exercise works on your hips and improves hip stability.

introduce: Sit upright with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Put your hands behind your head and open your elbows to the sides.\n\nHinge at your hips and lean your upper body forward. Come back and repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your back straight.
Put your knees hip-width apart and keep them still.
Bring your upper body as close to your thighs as possible.
Inhale as you lean forward, and exhale as you come back.
You can feel the stretch in your glutes and back.

introduce:
Sit upright with your feet flat on the floor.

Raise your arms overhead, then lower them to the sides of your legs.

Repeat the exercise. Keep your arms straight during the exercise.
name: CHAIR SIDE ARM RAISE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your arms straight during the exercise.
Pull your shoulders back.
Do not arch your back.
Exhale as you raise your arms, and inhale as you lower them.
This exercise targets your deltoids and upper back.
